title: Red-haired giant remains in American mountains came with the Phoenicians

tellings.quote: controversial I think that the reason why you find red-haired giants, >> the remains of redhaired giants in the mountains of America back in the the uh 18 and early 1900s is because they came over >> the sea with the phoenetians.

plain: Remains of red-haired giants were found in the mountains of America in the 1800s and early 1900s, and the reason, as one guest sees it, is that the giants came across the sea with the Phoenicians, the seafaring traders of the ancient Mediterranean. A researcher named Tim Alberino offers this as his own idea, and calls it controversial himself. He names no source. If he is right, people crossed the ocean to America long before Columbus.
